class.name: OcgToptoolsLocationset
class.brief_description: The class LocationSet stores a set of location in a relocatable state.
class.description: ! The class LocationSet stores a set of location in ! a relocatable state. ! ! It can be created from Locations. ! ! It can create Locations. ! ! It can be write and read from a stream.

method.name: TopTools_LocationSet
method.description: Returns an empty set of locations.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the content of the set.

method.name: Add
method.description: Incorporate a new Location in the set and returns its index.

method.name: Write
method.description: Writes the content of me on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: Read
method.description: Reads the content of me from the stream <IS>. me is first cleared.
